domain(person,[sapphire]).
% Sapphire is attuned to elements.
axiom(s1, attuned(sapphire,elements)).
% If Sapphire masters elemental magic, then she is either a skilled crystalweaver or can forge powerful talismans, but not both.
axiom(s2, rule([masters(sapphire,elemental_magic)], xor(skilled(sapphire,crystalweaver),forge(sapphire,powerful_talismans)))).
% Sapphire either crafts innovative jewelry or weaves protection spells, but not both.
axiom(s3, xor(craft(sapphire,innovative_jewelry),weave(sapphire,protection_spells))).
% Sapphire does not control water elements.
axiom(s4, not(control(sapphire,water_elements))).
% Sapphire does not create legendary artifacts.
axiom(s5, not(create(sapphire,legendary_artifacts))).
% If Sapphire wields earth energy or harnesses air magic, then she can master elemental magic.
axiom(s6, rule([or(wield(sapphire,earth_energy),harness(sapphire,air_magic))],masters(sapphire,elemental_magic))).
% If Sapphire is attuned to elements, then she is either able to craft innovative jewelry or forge powerful talismans, but not both.
axiom(s7, rule([attuned(sapphire,elements)],xor(craft(sapphire,innovative_jewelry),forge(sapphire,powerful_talismans)))).
% Sapphire summons fire energy.
axiom(s8, summon(sapphire,fire_energy)).
% Sapphire either summons fire energy or weaves protection spells, but not both.
axiom(s9, xor(summon(sapphire,fire_energy),weave(sapphire,protection_spells))).
% If Sapphire is a skilled crystalweaver, then she can either create legendary artifacts or revolutionize magical practices, but not both.
axiom(s10, rule([skilled(sapphire,crystalweaver)],xor(create(sapphire,legendary_artifacts),revolutionize(sapphire,magical_practices)))).
% Sapphire either controls water elements or harnesses air magic, but not both.
axiom(s11, xor(control(sapphire,water_elements),harness(sapphire,air_magic))).
